twine_ball.name: TWINE BALL
twine_ball.description: A woven ball. A fair chance to catch a wild Jakamon.

snare_ball.name: SNARE BALL
snare_ball.description: A tighter weave. Better odds than a Twine Ball.

dawn_seal.name: DAWN SEAL
dawn_seal.description: A warm seal that holds even a bright, stubborn Jakamon.

clear_dew.name: CLEAR DEW
clear_dew.description: Wakes a dazed Jakamon and eases sap.

dawn_feather.name: DAWN FEATHER
dawn_feather.description: Revives a fainted Jakamon to half HP.

trail_rope.name: TRAIL ROPE
trail_rope.description: Leaves a dungeon and returns to its entrance.

quiet_salt.name: QUIET SALT
quiet_salt.description: Wild Jakamon keep away for 80 steps.
